dog.description_text: Meet Murphy, a sweet 10-year-old gentleman who is ready to find a loving home to call his own! Murphy is a friendly, affectionate boy who truly loves being around people and getting all the cuddles he can. He is the definition of a companion dog and would be happiest spending his days by your side, whether that means relaxing on the couch or enjoying a car ride together. Murphy knows "sit," loves treats of all kinds (just skip the Greenies!), and goes to the groomer to keep himself looking his best. This laid-back guy is looking for a home where he can enjoy the simple things in life: cozy naps, loving company, and plenty of affection. At 10 years old, Murphy has so much love to give and would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal friend to share their days with. If you're looking for a cuddle buddy who will be happy just being near you, Murphy might be your perfect match!
dog.name: Murphy
